title: ignorefile configuration
description: Ignore rules kept as reviewable configuration. Sections and rules are ordered arrays because their order is semantic; comments are fields because JSON has no comment syntax.

header.description: Verbatim comment block above everything else, before the ### banner. Where a licence header lives. Each line renders as its own # line.

name.description: Rendered as a ### banner at the top of the output file.

target.description: One ignore file's worth of sections. Reused verbatim when other ignore files are added.

section.description: A commented group of rules, rendered under a ## header.

level.description: Comment depth of the header. 1 renders #, 2 renders ##.

note.description: Explanation under the header. Each line renders as its own # line.

rule.description: A group of patterns, optionally preceded by its own comment. Both pattern lists are optional here; that a rule needs at least one of them is enforced by Config::validate, which can say so in a useful message.

note.description: Explanation above the patterns. Each line renders as its own # line.

ignore.description: Patterns to ignore, verbatim, including any leading slash.

add.description: Patterns to re-include. Stored WITHOUT the leading ! that .gitignore writes; the renderer adds it.
